answer: Mechanism: Ratcheted Nonce Collision Ledger. Each agent forges a fresh 128-bit juniper seed and emits actions with a hash-chain nonce plus a periodic wharf heartbeat carrying its counter range. Peers gossip repeated (seed-hash, counter) pairs; the ledger quarantines both IDs. Cloning running state reproduces nonces, so the first divergent heartbeat exposes a public collision. Cost: attackers must provision and maintain independent seeds, counters, and heartbeat schedules per Sybil, not copy one instance.
